decisionsTitle: The bib designer: members' numbers with their own header and a mark, the sponsors at the bottom, the route's profile as a strip, an emergency phone, a distance badge and tear-off stubs
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-13:** «și BIB-uri, trebuie încă o setare pentru membrii BVR, trebuie să aibă ceva bifă, nu doar background, cel mai probabil nu vor avea alt background, ci doar alt header și încă o bifă».

**Decision.** Amends §664 (the members' number) and §695 (its background); §735's format and the numbering are untouched.

- **The race's own background, a header of their own.** The members' background choice already had the means: «Top band only» is the ordinary number with the members' header and label, and nothing under it changes. It is now named for what the club wants — «Același fundal ca restul numerelor — doar antet propriu» ("Same background as the other numbers — own header only") — and its help says so in one line. No third style value: it would draw exactly what `band` draws. Every stored design reads as it did.
- **The member mark.** A new tick in the members' object, `member.mark`, «Semn de membru pe număr» («Member mark on the number»), off by default, so every stored design reads as today. On, every member's number — and only a member's, and only while the members' number is on — carries a ring with a check mark in it: on the PDF sheet (members' pile included), on the picture (the bibs page and the desk) and in the editor's preview. It sits at the card's left inset, 12 points under the header's foot, 26 points across with a 2.4-point stroke, in the number's own ink (white on the whole card, the body ink on white), never a colour literal. It is beside the number rather than over it: the number is centred and, even at five digits at the largest size, reaches about 44 points from the card's edge, 26 from the inset, so it clears the ring. The name is another matter: when «Numele» is set above the number its box runs inset to inset and is cut exactly at the inset, so a long name (a double Romanian name with a hyphenated surname, about 35 characters at 24 points) would print over the ring. While the mark is drawn, the name above the number therefore gives up the mark's width plus a 10-point gap on each side in both renderers (`bibNameReserve`, `BIB_LAYOUT.memberMarkGap`): it stays centred and is cut with an ellipsis at least 10 points clear of the ring. The name below the number is nowhere near the mark and keeps its whole box. The mark is drawn as vector strokes from one set of points (`MEMBER_MARK_CHECK`) by both renderers, so no font has to carry a glyph and the sheet and the picture cannot differ; it reads at A5 and at half of it. It is not the house's icon registry's glyph: pdfkit cannot draw the registry's React icons, and one set of points keeps sheet and picture identical; the same SVG path could be drawn by `doc.path()` and Satori if the registry's look is wanted.
- **The editor.** Everything the members' number decides sits under «Membrii primesc un număr cu design propriu» through `OnlyWhenTicked` (hidden, still posted), the preview with it, and the mark's tick has its one-line «Bifat: … Debifat: …» help in both languages. The mark travels in the preview's address as `memberMark`, so the picture's address — and its cache — changes with it. The bibs page and the desk stamp the whole design (§748, below), so `member.mark` — and every key added since — enters both pictures' addresses. The ordinary preview's address carries `memberMark=1` only when the tick is on; a missing key reads false, so an unticked design is the address it always was.
- **No migration.** `events.bib_design` is a JSON column read through `readBibDesign`; a design without the key reads `mark: false`.

**Refused.** A mark in a font glyph (the sheet's fonts may not carry it, and the picture's would differ); a mark over the number; a separate switch for the picture and the sheet.

**The owner, 2026-10-13 (the sponsors' band):** «ar trebui normal jos de tot». He asked, in the same sitting, for a warning when the header image hides the event's name, for the race profile (elevation over distance, with the distance and the gain) on the number, and for an emergency phone on it.

**Decision.** Amends §249 (the sponsors' band and the header picture) and §748 (the picture's stamp); the numbering, the format and the allocator are untouched.

- **The sponsors' band's place: «Jos de tot, în subsol» by default.** A new setting «Locul benzii cu sponsori» (`sponsorPlace`), a select with a one-line help in both languages: `bottom` — «Jos de tot, în subsol», the default for every event, stored or not, because the owner said it belongs there — and `above` — «Deasupra subsolului», today's place between the number and the small print. At the bottom the strip is the number's last row, a row of its own *under* the small print rather than merged with it: the small print is one or two lines of 8-point text centred in its own strip and the strip's picture is 24 points tall, so merging them would make either a squeezed picture or a footer that moves when the club adds a second line; separate rows read as two things, the facts and then the partners, and cost nothing else, because the strip takes the same height in both places (the number's area and the member card's coloured part are the same size, only the order of the two rows under them changes). A design with no sponsors' picture draws exactly as before, whatever the place. The third place, «Sus, sub bandă», is not offered: under the band is where the member mark and the name set above the number already live, and a 30-point strip there would collide with both; it does not fit the design cleanly. Both renderers take the order from `design.sponsorPlace` (`footerFoot` and `sponsorTop` on the sheet, the two rows' order in the picture).
- **A warning, not a refusal.** While a picture is chosen in «Imagine în locul benzii colorate» and «Numele evenimentului» is ticked, a line in the card says the header image hides the event's name — nothing of the band is printed over a picture — and names the way out, «Bandă cu sponsori». It follows the boxes as they change (`BibHeaderWarning`, a text-only client island listening on the form like the preview does) and is right before any script runs, from the stored design. It changes nothing in the print.
- **«Profilul traseului»** (`showProfile`, off by default): a small elevation profile on every number, from the event's route GPX (§718). `bib-profile.ts` reads the file's `<trkpt>` (else `<rtept>`) points that carry an `<ele>` — `events/domain/route-gpx.ts` has only the upload's checks, no reader of the track, so the reader is added beside the only thing that needs one — resamples the elevation at even steps of distance, takes the jitter out with a three-point mean and keeps 64 points, never the file; the gain is summed over a finer 200-sample series so it does not depend on the drawing. It is computed once per request on the server (`bib-extras.ts#loadBibExtras`, read from the store through the adapter; a file that cannot be read is no profile, never a failed sheet). Beside the chart, the distance (km, one decimal) and the elevation gain (m): **the figures the club typed on the event win** («Distanță» and «Diferență de nivel», the numbers its page and its emails say), and the GPX's computed ones fill what it left empty — a watch's track carries its own noise, and the bib must say what the page says. The chart is vector paths in the sheet (pdfkit lines) and an SVG in the picture, in the number's own ink (the body ink, white on a member's card) with the area under the line at 14 per cent opacity, never a colour literal; «Start» and «Sosire» sit under its two ends. It is a row of its own, 38 points tall, between the name under the number and the small print, taken from the number's area — so it can never cover the number or the name, which keep every point they had. It sits above the sponsors' band and the small print whatever the band's place: the profile is the last thing the number says before the row of facts. Without a GPX the tick is greyed with the reason («Încarcă GPX-ul traseului în „Traseul”»); a design that stored the tick and then lost its GPX draws none.
- **«Telefon pentru urgențe»** (`showEmergency` and `emergencyPhone`, off by default): the tick and the phone the club types — the organizers' number — and the printed line «Urgențe: …» / "Emergency: …", one centred line of 9 points at a fixed place on every number, under the profile's row, in the number's ink. The phone is validated as a phone by the check «Telefon public» already applies (`isPhoneNumberShaped`: digits, spaces, brackets, dots, dashes and a leading +, six to fifteen digits, thirty characters), and normalised rather than refused like every field of the design: a value that is not a phone reads as none and prints nothing, and the box says so in its help. **Not the runner's own emergency contact**: that is personal data on a visible bib, which the privacy notice does not describe — refused for now, and a decision of its own if the club ever wants it.
- **Everywhere a number is drawn.** The PDF sheet (the members' pile and the spares included), the picture on the bibs page and at the desk, and the editor's live preview all read the same keys through the same two renderers and follow the same geometry (`BIB_LAYOUT.profile*`, `emergency*`, `bibExtrasHeight`); the preview's address carries the new keys (`sponsorPlace`, `showProfile`, `showEmergency`, `emergencyPhone`). The defaults keep every event as it is, except that the sponsors' strip, where an event has one, moves to the foot.
- **No stale picture.** The bibs page already stamped the whole design (§748); it now also stamps the route GPX's key and the typed figures. The desk's address was stamped with the number's format alone, so a ticked mark or a new element could be served from the browser's hour of cache after the club changed it: it carries the same whole-design stamp now, an `md5` over the event's design, colour, partners, GPX key, figures, title and date computed in the desk's query (`BIB_STAMP`), so any change of the design is a new address on both pages.
- **No migration.** The design is a JSON column read through `readBibDesign`; an old design reads `sponsorPlace: "bottom"`, no profile, no phone.

**Refused.** The runner's own emergency contact on the number; a third place, «Sus, sub bandă», which collides with the member mark and the name; the profile merged into the small print; a profile from the figures alone with no GPX; a colour literal for the chart.

**The owner, 2026-10-13 (two example bibs):** «just some examples of some bibs I like» — a marathon number (a header with the race's logo, dates and edition, a «21K» badge in its right corner, the number, the name, a footer of sponsors by tier with the number repeated small on both ends) and a trail number (the number, a full-width elevation strip with «23K» at its side, the emergency numbers printed upside down under it, a white sponsors' band). Examples to take from, not a design to copy; the photographs are not in the repository.

**Decision.** Amends this section's profile and phone, and §249's header; the numbering, the format and the allocator are untouched.

- **Taken, each a setting with a one-line help in both languages.** (1) «Distanța pe număr» (`showDistance`, off): a rounded badge in the header's right corner — `badgeWidth` × `badgeHeight` in the header's own text colour with «21K» in the band's colour on it, on a members' card a white tag with the body ink — from the event's *typed* distance in whole kilometres (`bibDistanceBadge`: 21 097 m reads «21K», under 500 m none), never from the GPX: the badge says what the page says. The race and its date give up the badge's width plus a gap on their right in both renderers (`bibHeaderReserve`); the members' label already sits under it. It is a band's and a card's header feature: a header *picture* replaces the band whole and a tag over an unknown photograph has no colour to read on, so none is drawn there, and the help says so. (2) «Tipărit invers» (`emergencyUpsideDown`, **on by default**, shown with the phone's box): the line turned half a circle about its own centre — `doc.rotate(180)` on the sheet, `rotate(180deg)` in the picture — so the runner reads it looking down at the chest, the trail practice; an old design reads it on, so a phone ticked earlier prints upside down now, which is the owner's call. (3) **The profile is now the strip.** The 38-point row stays, but its chart runs the card's width (380 points, was 250) with the distance and the gain at its right, which reads as the trail example's strip and costs the number nothing more; it sits above the small print and the sponsors' row whatever the place. The figures stay in the number's ink, no colour literal. (4) «Numărul și pe capetele subsolului» (`numberStubs`, off): the number again, 11 points bold, at both ends of the sponsors' row inside the inset; the row exists for the stubs alone when there is no picture, and a picture is scaled whole about its centre to what is left between them (`bibStubScale`, the crop and proportion kept exactly, both renderers).
- **Left.** Sponsor tiers (Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze with a heading over each): they need a model of sponsors — a list of logos, each with a tier and a link — where the design holds one picture the club composes itself; a tier heading inside that picture is the club's to draw. Asked of the owner. The «Parteneri» logos in the header and the edition line are the header picture's and the title's own words.
- **The number fits its area.** The profile's strip and the phone take their height from the number's area, but the number's size did not shrink, so with the rows on the digits could spill over the name (measured with Roboto Bold's own digits: 0.731 of the size tall, 0.574 wide each). `bibNumberFit` caps the club's size (`bibNumberPoints`) to the area's height over the digits' ink height and to the card's width less its inset, floored at 12 points, in the sheet and the picture alike from one `bibNumberArea`; an area that is big enough leaves the size exactly as the club chose it, so every design without the new rows prints as it did.
- **The profile is read once.** `loadBibExtras` downloaded the whole route GPX (up to 4 MB) and parsed it on every call — one per bib picture on the bibs page and the desk, and on every redraw of the preview. The parsed profile (64 points, the distance and the gain) is kept in a 16-entry least-recently-used map by `routeGpx.key`; a new upload has a new key, so it never goes stale. A failed read is never kept.
- **The phone's help** said "digits, spaces and a leading + only"; the check (`isPhoneNumberShaped`) accepts brackets, dots and dashes too, six to fifteen digits, and the help now says exactly that in both languages.
- **No migration, the stamp follows.** The three keys live in the design's JSON, read through `readBibDesign` (absent: off, off, upside down); the bibs page's and the desk's whole-design stamp covers them, with the typed distance already in it.
changelogLine: - **The bib designer: members, sponsors at the bottom, the route's profile, an emergency phone, a distance badge, stubs** — «Același fundal ca restul numerelor» (own header only) is named and «Semn de membru pe număr» puts a check mark on every member's number; the sponsors' strip is the number's last row by default («Jos de tot, în subsol») with a warning when the header image hides the event's name; «Profilul traseului» is a full-width strip with the distance and the gain, «Telefon pentru urgențe» prints «Urgențe: …» upside down by default («Tipărit invers»), «Distanța pe număr» puts a «21K» badge in the header and «Numărul și pe capetele subsolului» repeats the number small on the footer's two ends; the number's size never spills over the rows under it, and the route's file is read once — on the sheet, the picture, the desk and the editor's preview. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the members' number on with «Semn de membru pe număr» ticked, then every member's number — on the PDF sheet, the picture, the desk's picture and the members' pile — carries a ring with a check mark at the card's left inset under the header, in the number's own ink, drawn from one set of points by both renderers, and an ordinary number, a spare and any number while the members' number is off carry none; unticked, which every design stored before the key reads as, nothing is drawn (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). With «Numele» set above the number the name's box is narrowed on both sides by the mark's width plus a gap while the mark is drawn, in both renderers, so no letter prints over the ring.

A design saved before the member mark existed reads `member.mark` as false and the members' background as it was; the mark travels in the preview's address as `memberMark` and is read back by the same schema, so the picture's address changes when the tick does; the editor shows the members' fields, the mark's tick included, only while «Membrii primesc un număr cu design propriu» is ticked (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The members' band style is named «Același fundal ca restul numerelor — doar antet propriu» (the race's own background, the member's header and label only); criterion 70's quoted «Doar banda de sus» is superseded by it, and a design saved as `band` before reads as it (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Locul benzii cu sponsori» at «Jos de tot, în subsol» — the default for every event, stored or not — then on the PDF sheet and in the picture the sponsors' strip is the number's last row, under the small print, ending inside the card's foot; at «Deasupra subsolului» it is above the small print as before; and a number with no sponsors' picture is drawn identically at either place (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

While a picture is chosen in «Imagine în locul benzii colorate» and «Numele evenimentului» is ticked, the design panel shows a warning that the header image hides the event's name and names «Bandă cu sponsori»; it follows the boxes as they change and is hidden otherwise (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Profilul traseului» ticked and the event's route GPX readable, every number — sheet, picture and the editor's preview — draws, in a row of its own under the name that covers neither the number nor the name, a vector profile of 64 points of elevation over distance in the number's own ink, «Start» and «Sosire» under its ends, and the distance (km, one decimal) and the elevation gain (m), the event's own typed figures winning over the file's; unticked, or with no GPX, nothing is drawn, and the tick is greyed with the reason when the event has no GPX (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Telefon pentru urgențe» ticked and a phone typed that is written like a telephone number, every number prints «Urgențe: …» / "Emergency: …" as one small centred line at a fixed place under the profile's row, in the sheet, the picture and the preview; unticked, or with a value that is not a phone, nothing is printed, and the line is never the participant's own emergency contact (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A design saved before these keys existed reads the sponsors' place «Jos de tot», no profile and no phone, and prints as it did apart from the sponsors' strip; the preview's address writes `memberMark=1` only when the member mark is ticked, and the picture's address — on the bibs page and at the desk alike — is stamped with the whole design, so a changed mark, place, profile or phone is never served from the cache hour (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Distanța pe număr» ticked and the event's distance typed (500 m or more), a band's or a members' card's header shows a rounded badge in its right corner with the distance in whole kilometres and a K — «21K» — on the sheet, the picture and the preview, and the race and its date end short of it; unticked, without a distance or over a header picture, nothing is drawn (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Telefon pentru urgențe» ticked with a phone, «Tipărit invers» — on for every design that does not say otherwise — prints the line turned 180° about its own centre in the sheet and the picture, and unticked prints it upright; the profile is a strip across the card's width above the small print and the sponsors' row, with the distance and the gain at its right (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Numărul și pe capetele subsolului» ticked, the number is printed again, small, at both ends of the sponsors' row on every number — with or without a sponsors' picture, which is scaled whole to the room between them — in the sheet and the picture; unticked, nothing is added (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The number's digits never exceed the area the band, the name, the sponsors' row, the members' stripe, the profile and the phone leave them, nor the card's width less its inset, with every element on, at three, four and five digits, in the sheet and the picture; a design with room keeps the club's size, and the route's GPX is read from the store once per file key, not per picture (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the bib designer: members, sponsors at the bottom, the profile strip, an emergency phone, a distance badge, stubs
